summary.intent: Execute Phase 60 ('IPNS Verification Cross-Layer Closeout') of the CipherBox GSD workflow, implementing strict fail-closed IPNS verification across Rust and TypeScript layers via wave-based sequential subagent execution.
summary.outcome: Wave 1 (60-01, 60-02, 60-03) completed fully with 251/251 sdk-core tests passing. Wave 2 completed 60-04 and 60-05; 60-07 was being dispatched when the transcript ends. Wave 3 (60-06) and Wave 4 (60-08) not yet reached.

repo: The GSD harness cannot reliably merge back isolation='worktree' agent branches (no exposed worktree path/branch manifest), so sequential mode on the feature branch is the safe default for complex crypto phases.
sdk-core has 251 tests including 34 IPNS-specific tests that serve as the Wave 1 integration gate.
crates/fuse/src/verify.rs was a pure re-export shim; 60-01 moved the real impl to crates/api-client/src/ipns.rs, and 60-04 deleted the now-empty shim.
cipherbox-api-client gained ciborium + cipherbox-core dependencies for CBOR Validity parsing (added by 60-01 but Cargo.lock not committed until manually caught between 60-04 and 60-05).
Windows winfsp site is CI-gated and cannot be exercised locally; flagged as expected in 60-02.
60-01 executor folded all 9 FUSE VerifyError::Legacy caller arms as a compile necessity, absorbing work declared in 60-04's scope.

code.finding: Was referencing VerifyError::Legacy; mid-executor diagnostic showed E0599 but the arm was already folded to Invalid before the executor's final commit — stale snapshot diagnostic, not a real error.
Deleted in 60-04 after 60-01 moved the implementation to crates/api-client/src/ipns.rs. File should no longer exist.
Had stale expectation of sequence 0n that 60-03's executor updated to 1n to match the 60-02 producer unification.

workflow: The gsd-helper commit tool has a confirmed false-negative: it reports 'commit_failed' (No staged files match any configured task) even when the commit lands successfully. Always verify with git log after a reported failure.
Subagent executors that edit Cargo.toml do not reliably commit the resulting Cargo.lock changes; the orchestrator must audit for uncommitted lockfile drift between plans or risk --locked CI breaks.

Stray content (e.g. self-check footers) can be appended to SUMMARY files after an executor's closing commit, leaving factually incorrect artifacts in the tree; the orchestrator should inspect and revert these between waves.

A Wave N build/test gate catching cross-plan integration regressions is essential before dispatching Wave N+1 — the 60-01↔60-02 fuse/metadata and 60-02↔60-03 sdk-core integration was caught cleanly at the Wave 1 gate.

friction: Worktree isolation mode is not usable for this phase: the harness exposes no worktree path/branch manifest, making merge-back unreliable. Forced sequential mode adds wall-clock cost.
60-01 executor emitted a false E0599 compile error diagnostic (stale mid-edit snapshot), requiring the orchestrator to re-verify compilation manually before proceeding.
gsd-helper commit false-negative caused unnecessary ambiguity after the Cargo.lock commit; required manual git log verification.
60-01 executor committed Cargo.toml edits but left Cargo.lock uncommitted, creating a latent --locked CI break that had to be caught and fixed manually between Wave 2 plans.
Stray SUMMARY footer appended post-commit by 60-01 executor contained stale facts (claimed verify.rs FOUND after 60-04 deleted it); required manual revert.
